scope: This return folder, all source deltas relative to the accepted Mac baseline and the changed qualification documents. Unchanged accepted Mac history is not re-audited.
defaultReportStructure: All exported reports checked against the closed public projection; no identity, raw error, URL or arbitrary nested field.
sourceDeltaReview: 13 implementation/test files compared byte-for-byte with final tested code and reviewed; documentation deltas inspected. Test fixtures may intentionally contain synthetic canaries; runtime data is excluded.

media.visualReview: Previously inspected October 18 captions/native dialogs and keyframes; poster re-inspected October 24. Actual synthetic draft only.
media.containerMetadata: Only format/encoder, public tour title and synthetic-scope comment.

excluded: Raw credentials and generated runtime tokens
Raw logs, runtime homes, provider transcripts and testbeds
Private editor state, VHDs, daily memory and GAIT store
limitations: Pattern scans cannot establish absence of every unknown secret.
No whole-video OCR or speech-recognition audit was performed; exact hash preserves the previously inspected artifact.
Hashes/alias comparisons are evidence of the sampled synthetic files; they are not a complete filesystem forensics claim.
